name: Prices and cost of living
definition: How expensive everyday goods and services are for ordinary households.

name: Housing cost
definition: Rent, house prices and mortgage cost.

name: Energy and fuel
definition: Fuel, electricity and heating cost and supply.

name: Financial conditions
definition: Interest rates, credit availability and market stress.
grounding_series: policy rate, credit spreads, equity index

name: Job and income security
definition: How secure people's work and income are.

name: Crime and personal safety
definition: Crime and violence around people's daily life.
status: draft: was safety_fear; war and terror moved out

name: War and terror
definition: Armed conflict and terrorism affecting the audience's country or region.

name: Health risk
definition: Exposure to illness and strain on care.

name: Trust in institutions
definition: How credibly government, business and media are seen to act.
status: draft: may split government vs business/media

name: Community and belonging
definition: How connected and supportive local communities are.

name: Social division
definition: Polarisation and perceived unfairness in society.
status: draft: merges polarisation and inequality; split if overlap test says so

name: Technology pace
definition: How fast technology is changing daily life and work.

name: Disruption of routines
definition: Interruptions to travel, power, services, school and work (including weather).

name: Outlook (computed)
definition: How hopeful people feel. Computed from the other dials, never read from a story.

name: News overload
definition: Volume of reports per tick in the ledger. A fact about the media, not the world.
grounding_series: report counts in the ledger; GDELT
